meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 帮你编写和验证可安全跳转的 2D/3D 关键帧动画，包括 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等，并提供诊断命令来检查问题。
howto.when: 当你需要为 HyperFrames 合成创建或调试关键帧动画时触发，例如需要 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧或运行诊断命令。

say.text: 帮我写一个 GSAP 时间线，让方块从左边移到右边。
say.note: Claude 会生成代码并注册到全局时间线。

say.text: 检查当前动画的关键帧是否正确。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to write and verify seek-safe 2D/3D keyframe animations, including GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, etc., and provides diagnostic commands to check issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or debug keyframe animations for HyperFrames compositions, e.g., GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, or running diagnostics.

say_en.text: Write a GSAP timeline that moves a box from left to right.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code and register it in the global timelines.

say_en.text: Check if the current animation keyframes are correct.
say_en.note: Claude will run `hyperframes keyframes` and analyze the output.
